note: Monroe County WV publishes no county zoning ordinance or zoning districts layer; its ordinance list carries floodplain and improvement-location rules only. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web found no zoning district service for the county. Towns of Union and Peterstown show no zoning publications either. The only zoning-named ArcGIS hits were Jefferson County WV's Public Research Map and out-of-state Monroe County services.
